paragraphs.text: The following Capennan characters are only mentioned in flavor text or on legendary creature cards, appear as minor characters in the storyline , or are otherwise not notable enough to receive their own article.

Basil is a dark skinned human citizen who is a gossip and member of the Cabaretti family. They have black hair, a mustache, and dress flamboyantly. They were introduced as the digital Through the Omenpaths counterpart to Flash Thompson, Spider-Fan .
Zora is a human woman citizen with a fascination for spiders. She was introduced as the digital Through the Omenpaths counterpart to Aunt May .
